description: This Java class 'RoutingDataSourceServiceFactory' acts as a factory to provide the appropriate 'RoutingDataSourceService' based on the thread-local context. It uses Spring's ApplicationContext to retrieve beans dynamically depending on the context, specifically related to data source routing per tenant in the application.

classes.name: RoutingDataSourceServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class to obtain data source services based on thread-local context, facilitating dynamic data source routing in multi-tenant scenarios.

methods.name: determineDataSourceService
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RoutingDataSourceService bean based on the thread-local tenant context.
